components.description: Legally numbered invoices and credit notes rendered to PDF (factura PDF, numeración legal, abonos).

components.description: Monthly recurring charges on tokenised cards with dunning and payment retries (cobro recurrente, reintentos de pago).

components.description: Monthly box lineup curation with seasonal products, substitutions and cycle calendar (selección de productos de temporada, ciclo).

components.description: Monthly batch job that turns active subscriptions into fulfilment orders with inventory reservation (generación de pedidos por lote, reserva de stock).

components.description: Monthly subscription box plans, pricing and eligible products (suscripción mensual, caja sorpresa, plan).

components.description: Subscriber self-service to activate, pause, skip a month or cancel, with billing and cut-off rules (pausar, saltar un mes, baja).

components.name: Delivery options & delivery-day selector
components.description: Checkout step offering carriers, delivery slots and allowed delivery days computed from the cart contents (días de entrega, selector de envío).

components.name: Totals, rounding & edge-case handling
components.description: Order totals with promotions, weighted items and taxes, with rounding and edge cases covered by tests (redondeos, totales).

components.name: Search synonyms, typos & no-results analytics
components.description: Synonym dictionaries, typo tolerance and logging of zero-result queries to tune the catalog search (sinónimos, búsquedas sin resultados).

components.name: Food & wine pairing recommendations
components.description: Knowledge base of product pairings and a query layer that answers 'cheese for a red Rioja' style searches with ranked products (maridaje, recomendaciones).

components.name: Stock availability messaging
components.description: Per-product availability, low-stock and back-in-stock messaging driven by synced inventory (disponibilidad, aviso de stock).

components.name: Weight-based pricing & fractional quantities
components.description: Price per kilo and fractional quantities for cut-to-order products, with rounding rules in cart and invoice (precio por peso, al corte, cantidades fraccionadas).

components.name: Stock file parser & ETL
components.description: Parsing, validation and normalisation of legacy POS stock files into the shop inventory (parser de ficheros de stock, ETL).

components.name: Stock reconciliation & oversell prevention
components.description: Reconciliation between POS stock and web orders placed since the last export so nothing is sold twice (conciliación de stock, sobreventa).

components.name: FTP/SFTP connector to legacy POS exports
components.description: Nightly retrieval of CSV exports from a legacy point-of-sale over FTP/SFTP (TPV antiguo, ficheros CSV, FTP).
